text:
jules: Heads-up — cross-region promotion for search-indexer chart v1.8.0 is hitting a tag vs digest mismatch. deploy-bot blocked promotion at 14:10 UTC.

deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion check failed for search-indexer:chart v1.8.0
Regions: us-west, eu-central
Tag: registry.internal/search-indexer:release-1.8.0
eu-central digest: sha256:ff11aa...
us-west digest: sha256:dd22bb...
Action: HOLD - digest mismatch

sam: eu-central canary already passed smoke; us-west still pulling older mirror. Mirror team is on it but ETA unknown (~>1h). Change window closes in ~35m.

jules: Options: wait, rollback, or force digest in us-west via helm values override + annotate pin. Prefer override + pin to avoid rollback churn.

ops-lin: Agreed. Plan: 1) annotate release with `deploybot.pin=search-indexer@sha256:ff11aa` 2) helm upgrade in us-west with `--set image.digest=sha256:ff11aa --reuse-values` 3) run canary smoke in both regions and record RN.

clare: I'll run the helm override in us-west and apply the annotation. Then will post smoke results. Also creating RN ticket RN-1203 and infra ticket HOTFIX-650 for registry mirror follow-up.

deploy-bot: [ack] Pin annotation requested. Pin job queued: https://deploy.internal/jobs/pxy-4040

clare: Pin applied and helm upgrade started.

deploy-bot: [update] Pin job completed at 1799990045. Helm job finished: image pulled by digest in us-west, canary at 10%

clare: Smoke: p95 135ms, errors 0.07% in us-west. No image pull errors. RN-1203 created: "Pinned image digest across regions due to registry mirror skew; no customer impact."

jules: TL;DR: Manual digest override + deploy-bot pin to ensure binary consistency across regions. Follow-ups: HOTFIX-650 (registry mirrors) and remove pin after sync."
